essence: The visualized form is a thick, pearl-like mass flowing in continuous and broken streams.
The supreme form is constantly beheld by herds of cows together with their upturned-faced calves.
The supreme form is adorned by cowherds with sticks and nooses raised in their hands.
The supreme beyond supreme is praised with speech full of affection and tenderness.
The satisfied deity grants the worshipper the desired boon at the three junctures.
